decision_rule.confirmed_price: Current official site shows a public price applicable to the queued treatment. A related but materially different treatment is not substituted.
decision_rule.official_no_public_price: Current official site confirms the queued treatment/therapy is offered, but no public treatment fee is shown after checking the relevant official page(s).
decision_rule.unconfirmed: Official site cannot be adequately inspected, or the current official site does not establish a sufficiently close match to the queued treatment. Related-treatment prices are not reused.
